claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_use_trigger (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tactical Shift fires automatically when Second Wind is activated — it is not independently activated. No 'on_use_trigger' or 'passive_rider' family exists in ClassFeatureMechanics. The existing 'activation' family requires an independent activationCost, use_count resource, and resetCadence, none of which apply here. Encoding with a fake resource would produce a dishonest trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you activate your Second Wind with a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_movement (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect grants movement (up to half Speed) with opportunity attack denial. Neither GrantExtraActionEffect nor HealHpEffect covers this. The v4 taxonomy has 'move' and 'deny_opportunity_attack' atoms, but no surface shape in ClassFeatureEffect exposes them.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks
